per_question.response:
Yes, the RAM on the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 (Intel) is upgradeable.

According to the provided documentation, the device features two DDR5 SODIMM slots that are dual-channel capable (*ThinkPad_T14_Gen_5_Intel_Spec.pdf*, page 2). It supports up to 64GB of DDR5-5600 memory (*ThinkPad_T14_Gen_5_Intel_Spec.pdf*, page 2; *1782724743821_thinkpad_t14g5_t16g3_p14sg5_en.pdf*, page 14).
per_question.reference: Yes. The laptop uses two replaceable DDR5 SO-DIMM memory modules.
